meta.title: About — HatchGrab
meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile caterers: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.

title: Built around the way food trucks actually work

story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.
story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
